verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The market empties out and the pigeons take the square.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
wings clatter up like applause for no one
then settle back to the same gray stones

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the same gray stones hold yesterday's rain
a puddle mirrors the empty sky
where no one claps and no one watches

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone left a glove on the bench
the puddle doesn't reach that far

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
fingers curled where a hand once was
the cold keeps that shape a little longer

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a sparrow lands where the wrist would be
weighing nothing, changing nothing

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
it lifts off before the cold notices
the glove keeps its small empty promise

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone will come back for it, maybe
the bench keeps its patience out of habit

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
snow gathers where the patience wears thin
morning erases the shape of waiting

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the shape forgets it was ever kept
someone's boots make a new one, walking through

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a new print fills the old one without asking
even the snow forgets which foot came first

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the road takes whatever foot arrives
no memory left to argue whose

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a stranger's shadow settles in the ruts
the road hums the same song for everyone

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
morning erases what the humming meant
the tracks stay warm a minute, then belong to no one

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
someone else's breath still hangs above the ruts
mistaken, by the trees, for smoke of home

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the trees don't mind the lie, they lean in anyway
warming their bare arms on a stranger's breath
